blocks.title: Trusted contact
blocks.sub: Someone who knows you well and can check in if you need support

rows.title: How it works
rows.desc: If a conversation in Isonomic indicates a serious safety concern, we may notify your trusted contact so they can check in with you. They must be 18 or older.

blocks.title: No trusted contact
blocks.text: Add someone you trust. They will be asked to accept.
